in_marathi.name: Purnamita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purnamita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Symbolizing completeness and fullness. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Purna', meaning 'complete'.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'पूर्ण' (pūrṇa), meaning fullness or completeness. In Hinduism, the full moon day is considered auspicious and is celebrated as a festival. This name is often given to a child born on such a day.
